description.en: Control JBL soundbars supported by the JBL One app over your local network. Media player with power, volume, mute, play/pause and source selection; a full remote with sound modes (Smart Mode, Bass, Atmos, Calibration, Moment); switches for Night Mode, Smart Mode and Pure Voice; an EQ preset selector; and rear-speaker battery sensors. Soundbars are discovered automatically. No JBL account required - control is entirely local.

value.en: On the next screen your JBL soundbars are discovered automatically. Leave the IP address blank to auto-discover, or enter it manually if discovery does not find your soundbar. The soundbar must be powered on and connected to your network.
